description: linear_equalizer with LMS decision directed from the start (zero initial weights)

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Output rounded to the format (half an LSB, 1.5e-5 at Q15) and the weights in 28 fractional bits; the weights follow the float ones within 1e-6 because the step is applied to 13 bits finer weights than the samples; the output error is the rounding of the output only.

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: The same recurrence in f32 on both sides; GNU Radio forms the dot product and the update with volk kernels in another summation order: differences of 3e-7 (measured) that the adaptation does not amplify at these step sizes.
